system.description:
Elemental Cloak

Fortitude Amp

Taijutsu you cast deal its nature releases associated damage type and your chosen nature release grants your cloak different benefits.

Earth Release: You gain +4 DR. This DR cannot be reduced by any means. When you reach 10th, you gain 30 feet of tremor sense. Increase DR to +6 at 17th level.

Wind Release: You gain a +1 Bonus to AC, and damage you deal with Taijutsu penetrates 2 of a creatures DR. When you reach 10th level, you gain immunity to the Grappled and Restrained conditions. Finally, when you reach 17th level, your bonuses becomes +2 to AC and penetrates 4 DR.

Fire Release: You gain a rank of Mastery to [Unarmed Damage]. This becomes two ranks of Mastery at 10th and three ranks at 17th level.

Water Release: Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 and Trip weapon properties. Beginning at 10th level the first time each turn you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature you can move them up to 10 feet in any direction of your choice. Finally, at 17th level, level creatures cannot gain jutsu based bonuses to their saving throws vs Taijutsu you cast.

Lightning Release: Your unarmed and Taijutsu attacks gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range and a +10 to speed. Beginning at 10th level, when you score a critical with an unarmed attack, you may add 1 unarmed damage die to the result. Finally, at 17th level, [Unarmed Damage] you deal cannot have its damage intercepted, always affecting its original target.

The Taijutsu specialist who Blend their style with Ninjutsu open up a world of unpredictability and technique. They have found ways to further augment their body beyond simple Taijutsu, but instead coating their body in a given Nature Releases and magnifying their strength and greatly increasing their potential.
